name: Guilloche
description: Rings linked into a mesh, every ring passing over one neighbor and under the next, the under strand broken where it crosses, like interlaced chain.

code.style: --rule: ( --k: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -20%; background: @p(@var(--k)); -webkit-mask: @var(--over); mask: @var(--over); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -20%; background: @var(--k); -webkit-mask: @var(--under); mask: @var(--under); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --over: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 83%, #000 83% 96%, transparent 96%), conic-gradient(from 0deg, #000 0 90deg, transparent 90deg 180deg, #000 180deg 270deg, transparent 270deg 360deg); --under: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 83%, #000 83% 96%, transparent 96%), conic-gradient(from 90deg, #000 0 90deg, transparent 90deg 180deg, #000 180deg 270deg, transparent 270deg 360deg), radial-gradient(ellipse 100% 100% at -21.43% 50%, #000 39%, transparent 39% 50.5%, #000 50.5%), radial-gradient(ellipse 100% 100% at 121.43% 50%, #000 39%, transparent 39% 50.5%, #000 50.5%), radial-gradient(ellipse 100% 100% at 50% -21.43%, #000 39%, transparent 39% 50.5%, #000 50.5%), radial-gradient(ellipse 100% 100% at 50% 121.43%, #000 39%, transparent 39% 50.5%, #000 50.5%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
